items.title: Business-Class.com Partners Directly With Turkish Airlines as 78 Percent of Its U.S. Travelers Connect Through Istanbul
items.summary: Turkish Airlines, the airline flying to more countries than any other, and Business-Class.com, an advisor-led platform for premium international travel, have announced a direct partnership covering the United States market.

items.title: Turkish Airlines and CFM sign MOU for more than 600 LEAP-1B engines
items.summary: Includes 300 LEAP-1B engines to power up to 150 new 737 MAX aircraft; long-term services for entire fleet of 600+ LEAP-1B engines; and material services agreement to support the airline’s future engine MRO shop Turkish Airlines and CFM sign MOU for more than 600 LEAP-1B engines The MoU was signed during a ceremony in Istanbul by Prof. Murat Şeker, Chairman of the Board and the Executive Committee

items.title: Boeing Lands Massive 150-Plane Deal With Turkish Airlines
items.summary: Turkish Airlines Bets Big on Boeing With Up to 150 737 Max Jets

items.title: Turkish Airlines orders 150 Boeing 737 MAX jets in major new deal
items.summary: Turkish Airlines said on Wednesday it was to buy 150 jets from Boeing that would be scheduled for delivery between 2033 and 2037.View on euronews

items.title: BA Lands Turkish Airlines’ 737 MAX Deal For Up To 150 Jets — It’s Boeing’s Largest Single-Aisle Order From The Carrier
items.summary: Turkish Airlines will add 100 Boeing 737-8 aircraft to its fleet and has options for another 50 MAX jets.
